lines.en: Welcome to the team. Your desk is on the third floor.
lines.zh: 歡迎加入團隊。你的座位在三樓。

lines.en: Thank you. Do I need a badge to enter the building?
lines.zh: 謝謝。我進大樓需要識別證嗎？

lines.en: Yes. I will give you one after lunch. Please bring your ID.
lines.zh: 要的。午餐後我會給你一張。請帶你的身分證件。

lines.en: Okay. When can I meet my manager?
lines.zh: 好的。我什麼時候可以見到我的主管？

lines.en: She will see you at nine tomorrow.
lines.zh: 她明天九點會見你。

questions.en: Where is the new employee's desk?
questions.zh: 新進員工的座位在哪裡？

questions.en: What will the new employee get after lunch?
questions.zh: 新進員工午餐後會拿到什麼？

questions.en: What will happen at nine tomorrow?
questions.zh: 明天九點會發生什麼事？
options: The new employee will meet a client
The new employee will meet the manager

lines.en: Hello. I would like to order fifty chairs for the new office.
lines.zh: 你好。我想為新辦公室訂五十張椅子。

lines.en: Fifty is fine. When do you need them?
lines.zh: 五十張沒問題。你們什麼時候要？

lines.en: By next Friday, if possible.
lines.zh: 可以的話，下週五以前。

lines.en: Friday is difficult. I can send them on Monday.
lines.zh: 週五有困難。我可以週一送過去。

lines.en: Monday is okay. What is the price for each chair?
lines.zh: 週一可以。每張椅子多少錢？

lines.en: It is forty dollars. I will send the invoice today.
lines.zh: 四十元。我今天會寄發票。

questions.en: Why is the manager calling?
questions.zh: 主管為什麼打電話？

questions.en: What is the problem?
questions.zh: 問題是什麼？
options: The chairs cannot come by Friday

questions.en: What will the supplier do today?
questions.zh: 供應商今天會做什麼？

lines.en: Where is the team meeting today?
lines.zh: 今天的團隊會議在哪裡？

lines.en: We have ten people, so we need a big room.
lines.zh: 我們有十個人，所以需要大一點的房間。

lines.en: Is the smallest room too small?
lines.zh: 最小的房間會太小嗎？

lines.en: Yes. Please book the biggest one.
lines.zh: 會。請訂最大的那一間。

questions.en: Look at the table. Which room will the meeting use?
questions.zh: 請看表格。會議會用哪一間房間？

questions.en: How many people are coming to the meeting?
questions.zh: 有多少人要來開會？

lines.en: Excuse me. My flight is late. Can I change to another flight?
lines.zh: 不好意思。我的班機延誤了。我可以改搭別班嗎？

lines.en: The next flight leaves at six. It has one seat.
lines.zh: 下一班六點起飛。還有一個位子。

lines.en: I will take it. Do I need a new boarding pass?
lines.zh: 我要搭那班。我需要新的登機證嗎？

lines.en: Yes. Please wait here, and I will print it.
lines.zh: 需要。請在這裡等，我來列印。

questions.en: What does the speaker want to do?
questions.zh: 這位旅客想做什麼？

questions.en: What will the agent do next?
questions.zh: 櫃檯人員接下來會做什麼？
options: Make a call to the hotel

lines.en: Hello. I bought this printer last week, but it does not work.
lines.zh: 你好。我上週買了這台印表機，可是它不能用。

lines.en: I am sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
lines.zh: 很抱歉聽到這件事。你有收據嗎？

lines.en: No, I lost it. I paid by card.
lines.zh: 沒有，我弄丟了。我是刷卡付的。

lines.en: That is fine. I can find it on the computer. Do you want a new printer or your money back?
lines.zh: 沒關係。我可以在電腦上查到。你想要新的印表機，還是退錢？

lines.en: A new one, please.
lines.zh: 請給我新的。

lines.en: Okay. It will take ten minutes.
lines.zh: 好的。需要十分鐘。

questions.en: What is the customer's problem?
questions.zh: 顧客遇到什麼問題？

questions.en: What did the customer lose?
questions.zh: 顧客弄丟了什麼？

questions.en: What does the customer choose?
questions.zh: 顧客選擇了什麼？

lines.en: Your booth is very busy today.
lines.zh: 你們的攤位今天很熱鬧。

lines.en: Yes. Many people like our new phone.
lines.zh: 對啊。很多人喜歡我們的新手機。

lines.en: Can I get some samples? My team wants to try them.
lines.zh: 我可以拿一些樣品嗎？我的團隊想試用。

lines.en: Sure, but we have only ten left. Come back tomorrow for more.
lines.zh: 當然可以，不過我們只剩十個。明天再來拿更多。

lines.en: Okay. I will bring my manager at noon.
lines.zh: 好。我中午會帶我的主管來。

lines.en: Great. I will keep some for you.
lines.zh: 太好了。我會幫你留一些。

questions.en: Why does the client talk to the guide?
questions.zh: 客戶為什麼找導覽人員說話？

questions.en: What problem does the guide mention?
questions.zh: 導覽人員提到什麼問題？
options: There are only ten samples left

questions.en: What will the client do tomorrow?
questions.zh: 客戶明天會做什麼？

lines.en: A customer wants some cables. Which shelf are they on?
lines.zh: 有位顧客想要一些電線。它們在哪個架子上？

lines.en: Let me look at the list. I can bring them.
lines.zh: 我看一下清單。我可以把它們拿來。

lines.en: Good. Please bring all of them to the door.
lines.zh: 好。請把全部都拿到門口。

questions.en: Look at the table. Which shelf will the coworker go to?
questions.zh: 請看表格。同事會去哪個架子？

questions.en: Look at the table. How many boxes will the coworker bring?
questions.zh: 請看表格。同事會拿幾箱？

lines.en: The party is on Friday evening. Can you help with the food?
lines.zh: 派對在週五晚上。你可以幫忙準備食物嗎？

lines.en: Of course. How many people are coming?
lines.zh: 當然。有多少人會來？

lines.en: About sixty. Please order the food today.
lines.zh: 大約六十個。請今天訂食物。

lines.en: I will call the restaurant this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我今天下午會打電話給餐廳。

questions.en: What does the director ask the coworker to do?
questions.zh: 主管請同事做什麼？

questions.en: When will the coworker call the restaurant?
questions.zh: 同事什麼時候打電話給餐廳？
